incidentbot: PagerDuty high-priority incident triggered: PD123456 - hosted-inference /v1/generate 5xx spike (5m > 3σ). Paging primary on-call...

pagerduty-bot: Page fired -> PD123456. Primary: maya (acked). Secondary: sam (no response). Escalation to manager in 3m :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): Acked, investigating. Seeing elevated 500s; traces point to batcher timeouts and grpc EOFs. Grabbing logs now.

maya (oncall): quick check — traffic is skewed to `rwd/xlarge-quant` with long KV-cache warmups; some workers stuck in loop. Trying warm restart of target workers.

sam (secondary): I'm on mobile and was in DND, couldn't reach VPN earlier. Trying to SMS/voice now, sorry for the delay.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: secondary unresponsive -> notifying manager lee.

lee (manager): On it. Joining bridge. @jordan please open prod bridge and run quick capacity check.

jordan (sre): Bridge created: https://meet/bridge/6234567890
jordan (sre): Running `kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide` — several pods `CrashLoopBackOff` or `Evicted` on node gpu-7.

jordan (sre): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:15:23Z inference-serving ERROR batch_timeout exceeded for request 0xabc
2026-03-15T10:15:24Z grpc transport failed: EOF
2026-03-15T10:15:25Z kv-cache miss spike warming up
```

maya (oncall): Initiating immediate mitigation: roll 10% traffic to fallback model `rwd/faster-lite:v2` as canary, and restart crashed pods. If stable, ramp to 100%.

alex (prodops): Scaling inference pool +4 GPUs: `scale set --pool inference-prod --replicas 12` — pushing now.

maya (oncall): After canary -> 5xx rate dropped from ~5.2% -> 0.9% within 2 minutes. Rolling to 100%.

pagerduty-bot: PD123456 acknowledged by lee (manager). :white_check_mark:

jordan (sre): Customer impact estimate: roughly ~4% of requests returned 5xx across us-west-2 between 10:12–10:20 UTC. No SLA breach yet but close margin.

lee (manager): Good catch. Prepare public status update and notify support. @alex handle status page and banner.

alex (prodops): Drafted message in #support-desk — "We experienced elevated errors on hosted inference; traffic routed to fallback model and service stabilized. We're investigating root cause."

maya (oncall): Follow-ups: open postmortem INF-2026-45; add runbook step to auto-route traffic to fallback after error threshold; improve PD escalation for DND/mobile (SMS+call). :memo:

sam (secondary): I'm on VPN now; apologies for the missed ack — phone DND blocked PD call. Will update contact methods and test reachability.

lee (manager): Action items agreed: (1) PD contact methods review; (2) add proactive KV-cache warmup healthcheck; (3) investigate batcher kernel and GC that coincided with node gpu-7 evictions.

maya (oncall): Marking PD incident resolved after stabilization. Will write postmortem with timeline. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incidentbot: PD incident PD123456 resolved at 6234567955 (closed by maya, lee).
